data.name: Krishnamurthy
data.gender_notes: Krishnamurthy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Krishna means 'black' or 'dark' and Murthy means 'god'. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector and preserver of wealth. Krishna is a central figure in Hindu mythology and is known for his mischievousness, love for butter, and his role as an avatar of Vishnu. The name Krishnamurthy carries the meaning “God-protector of wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krishnamurthy usually hope their child will grow to embody god-protector of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Krishnamurthy belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God-protector of wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krishnamurthy total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
